scope: Read-only in-process probes with synthetic inputs and in-memory SQLite; no network, model calls, or production changes. These demonstrate local behavior, not end-to-end task error rates.

probes.name: connector_abstract_identity

input.title: Example abstract
input.text: This is only the abstract. Methods and limitations are in the paper.

observed.terminal_message: End of available extracted source text; there is no later text window in this snapshot.

probes.interpretation: Material identity is lost. The terminal message is accurate about available snapshot text but does not disclose abstract-only scope. Actual semantic harm was not measured.

probes.name: hyperresearch_non_numeric_clause_overreach
probes.sqlite_schema: CREATE TABLE claims(note_id TEXT, claim TEXT, quoted_support TEXT, numbers TEXT)

input.claim_and_quoted_support: The system supports concurrent writes only when the feature is enabled.
input.sentence: The system supports concurrent writes only when the feature is enabled, and it also supports them when the feature is disabled.

probes.interpretation: A matching six-word span can auto-pass a sentence containing an additional unsupported and contradictory clause. This is a triage counterexample, not an end-to-end model trial.

probes.name: hyperresearch_independence_cluster_weight
sqlite_schema: CREATE TABLE notes(id TEXT, source TEXT, title TEXT, created TEXT, independence REAL, type TEXT)
CREATE TABLE note_content(note_id TEXT, body_plain TEXT)
CREATE TABLE tags(note_id TEXT, tag TEXT)

input.notes: n0..n4; sources https://example0.org/story .. https://example4.org/story; type=source; title=Same story; created=2026-11-01 .. 2026-11-05
input.same_body_for_all: This identical source text is republished by multiple outlets and contains the same factual claims.

probes.interpretation: Summing stored independence weights does not implement one vote per cluster. The step-3 instruction mentions both approaches, so reuse should explicitly count clusters instead of copying this sum.

probes.name: hyperresearch_weak_pair_sampling
probes.interpretation: The default 0.6 sampling rate is not complete semantic review of all remaining non-strong pairs.
